query:
SELECT user_id AS "user_id!", artist_id AS "artist_id!",
               sum(play_count * power(0.5, extract(epoch FROM $1::timestamptz - day)
                                           / 86400.0 / $2::float8))::float8 AS "plays!",
               max(day) AS "last!"
        FROM scrobbles_daily_by_artist
        WHERE day < $1
        GROUP BY 1, 2
